dialogue.content: 本日はどうぞよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: おはようございます。今日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.content: まだ少し早いですが、もしご準備がよろしければ始めさせていただいても大丈夫でしょうか（時間どおりがよろしければ遠慮なくおっしゃってください）
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but if you're ready, would it be alright to start now? (If you'd prefer to begin right on time, please don't hesitate to let me know.)

dialogue.content: 時間通りでお願いします
dialogue.English: I'd prefer to start on time, please.

dialogue.content: 了解いたしました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です本日はご相談にきてくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in to talk today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: まずはじめに、ご年齢と性別をお教えいただけますでしょうか
dialogue.English: First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 49代、女性です
dialogue.English: I'm in my 40s, female.

dialogue.content: 40代です
dialogue.English: I'm in my 40s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 夫の転勤先で孤立して、辛いです。
dialogue.English: I feel isolated at the place we moved to for my husband's job, and it's tough.

dialogue.content: それはとても寂しいですよね、、
dialogue.English: That must feel very lonely.

dialogue.content: ええ、住み慣れた街から離れて
dialogue.English: Yes, being away from the town I was used to.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 友達もいないし、子どもたちの学校のことも分からず
dialogue.English: I have no friends here, and I don't know much about my children's school.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 毎日、一人でとても寂しいです。
dialogue.English: I'm all alone every day and it's very lonely.

dialogue.content: 誰か話しできる人が欲しいって思いますよね・・・
dialogue.English: You must wish you had someone to talk to...

dialogue.content: はい、仕事も辞めてきているので、
dialogue.English: Yes, and I quit my job to move here, so...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.English: Oh, I see...

dialogue.content: 毎日ハリがないというか。。。虚しい感じです。
dialogue.English: Each day feels flat... kind of empty.

dialogue.content: うんうん、やることが無いと気が滅入ってしまいますよね・・
dialogue.English: Yes, when there's nothing to do, it can really get you down...

dialogue.content: そうですね。家のことだけで、何だか滅入っています
dialogue.English: That's right. Just doing things around the house... it gets me down.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I can understand that...

dialogue.content: 学校行事もコロナの影響で参観も中止で
dialogue.English: School events and class observations have also been canceled due to COVID.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 他の保護者の方と会う機会もなくて、
dialogue.English: So I don't have any opportunities to meet other parents,

dialogue.content: この土地で知り合いを作る機会もない状況です
dialogue.English: and no chances to make acquaintances in this area.

dialogue.content: それはとても寂しいですよね、、
dialogue.English: That must feel very lonely.

dialogue.content: ええ、なんか取り残された気分です。
dialogue.English: Yes, I feel kind of left behind.

dialogue.content: うんうん、孤独を感じてしまうのも無理ないですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it's completely understandable that you'd feel so isolated...

dialogue.content: 以前はフルタイムで仕事していて、職場の仲間と
dialogue.English: I used to work full-time, and with my colleagues at work,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: よく話したり、時々ランチして楽しかったんです
dialogue.English: we would talk a lot, and sometimes we'd have lunch together. It was fun.

dialogue.content: 以前は本当にいい関係を作っておられたのですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you had truly wonderful relationships before.

dialogue.content: それが今は・・・
dialogue.English: And now...

dialogue.content: そうなんです。夫は仕事、子どもたちは学校で
dialogue.English: That's right. My husband is at work, my children are at school,

dialogue.content: 私だけなにもない毎日が辛いです。
dialogue.English: and I'm the only one with nothing going on—it's hard.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、一人だけ取り残された気持ちになってしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: I understand... It must feel like you're the only one left behind...

dialogue.content: はい、仕事をこっちでも始めたいのですが
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like to start working here too, but...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 下の子もなかなか新しい土地に馴染めず
dialogue.English: my younger child is having a hard time adjusting to the new place,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 時々学校へ行けない日があるのですぐには無理かと思っています。
dialogue.English: There are days they can't go to school, so I don't think it's possible for me to work right away.

dialogue.content: 大切なお子さんのこと考えると、今すぐには仕事には行きづらいですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Thinking about your precious child, it must be difficult to start working right now...

dialogue.content: ちなみにお子さんはおいくつですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how old are your children?

dialogue.content: ええ、今はちょっと大事な時期かなと思っています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think this is a pretty crucial time for them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい、一人でいえにいると何やっているんだろうと思えて、孤独を感じてしまいます。
dialogue.English: Yes, when I'm home alone, I wonder what I'm even doing, and I feel lonely.

dialogue.content: 以前は外で活発に動いておられたので、今の状況はなおさら辛いですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Since you were so active outside the home before, the current situation must be especially difficult for you...

dialogue.content: はい・・・辛いです
dialogue.English: Yes... it's hard.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ちなみに今のところに来られてどれくらい経ちますか
dialogue.English: By the way, how long has it been since you moved here?

dialogue.content: そうですね、昨年の夏休み明けからです。
dialogue.English: Let's see, since after last year's summer break.

dialogue.content: 半年ほど経ちました
dialogue.English: It's been about six months.

dialogue.content: 家族以外の誰とも話すこともないまま
dialogue.English: Without talking to anyone other than my family,

dialogue.content: 毎日家にいます。
dialogue.English: I've been at home every day.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、半年もそんな生活をしていたらしんどくなるもの無理ないですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. It's no wonder you're feeling worn out after half a year like that...

dialogue.content: ええ、この先どうしたらいいか分からず
dialogue.English: Yes, I don't know what to do going forward,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 自分だけ社会から置いてけぼりな気もしています。
dialogue.English: and I feel like I'm the only one being left behind by society.

dialogue.content: どんどん孤独感が増していってしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: That feeling of loneliness must be growing stronger and stronger...

dialogue.content: ええ、日を追うごとにですね。。
dialogue.English: Yes, day by day...

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: That's really true...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに今は夫さんとはどんなふうな関わりをしていますか
dialogue.English: By the way, what is your relationship with your husband like right now?

dialogue.content: 夫は割と帰りが遅いので、
dialogue.English: My husband tends to come home late,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 平日はあまり話をしていないです。
dialogue.English: so we don't talk much on weekdays.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 寂しいですよね・・・
dialogue.English: That must feel lonely.

dialogue.content: はい。一度、話す人もいなくて寂しいと漏らしたことはあるのですが
dialogue.English: Yes. I once mentioned to him that I was lonely and had no one to talk to,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 夫は。「そうか、辛いね」と言ってはくれました
dialogue.English: and he did say, "I see, that must be hard."

dialogue.content: 休日は御飯作ってくれたり、気遣いはしてくれます。
dialogue.English: On his days off, he cooks for me and is considerate.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、ちゃんと気遣ってくれて優しい夫さんなのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so he's a kind and considerate husband.

dialogue.content: はい、優しい人です。でもあまり一緒に過ごす時間がないですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, he's a kind person. But we don't have much time to spend together.

dialogue.content: もっと一緒にいたいですよね・・・でも仕事があるし・・
dialogue.English: You wish you could be together more... but he has work...

dialogue.content: どちらかと言うと、家族以外の社会とのつながりを私は求めているのかなと思っています。
dialogue.English: If I had to say, I think I'm seeking a connection with society outside of my family.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それが満たされないことで、虚しいのかなって思っています。
dialogue.English: I think I feel empty because that need isn't being met.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうですよね以前は仲間と楽しくやっていたんですものね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that makes sense, especially since you had such a good time with your colleagues before.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: ちなみに以前のお仲間とは連絡は取っておられますか
dialogue.English: By the way, are you in touch with your former colleagues?

dialogue.content: たまにLINEをするときもありますが、
dialogue.English: I sometimes message them on LINE,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 忙しいだろうなと思うと遠慮してしまいますね。
dialogue.English: I hesitate because I assume they're busy.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・気をつかってしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: I understand... you're being considerate of them...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに　お子さんとのご関係は今はどんな感じですか
dialogue.English: By the way, what is your relationship with your children like now?

dialogue.content: 子どもが二人なのですが、
dialogue.English: I have two children,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 上の子は小5で、お友達もできているので、
dialogue.English: my older one is in fifth grade and has made friends,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私べったりではなく、友だちとよく遊んでいる感じで、こっちから聞けば
dialogue.English: so they're not clingy with me and often play with their friends. If I ask them things,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話をしてくれます。ちょっと思春期に差し掛かってきているので
dialogue.English: they'll talk to me. They're starting to enter puberty,

dialogue.content: 向こうから話してくることはあまりないです
dialogue.English: so they don't often initiate conversations.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 下の子はまだ低学年で、人見知りもあるので
dialogue.English: My younger child is still in the lower grades and is a bit shy around strangers, so,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私にまだ甘えるようなところがあります。
dialogue.English: so they still lean on me a lot.

dialogue.content: 子供との関係は悪くないと感じています
dialogue.English: I feel my relationship with my children isn't bad.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、お子さんのことを本当によく見ておられて、こんなお母さんに育てられているお子さんは幸せだろうなと感じました
dialogue.English: I see. You pay such close attention to your children; I imagine they feel fortunate to be raised by a mother like you.

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: Oh, not at all.

dialogue.content: 子供との遊び方とかよくわからないので
dialogue.English: I don't really know how to play with children,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: あんまり熱心に関わる母親ではないです。
dialogue.English: so I'm not a very engaged mother.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じておられるのですね
dialogue.English: That's how you feel about it.

dialogue.content: ええ、だから、仕事をしているときのほうが充実感とか、楽しいとか
dialogue.English: Yes, that's why, when I was working, I felt more fulfilled and had more fun.

dialogue.content: 感じられるんですよね。
dialogue.English: That's what I could feel.

dialogue.content: 子育てを心の底から楽しめる人が羨ましいです
dialogue.English: I envy people who can truly enjoy parenting from the bottom of their hearts.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、そんな思いもお持ちだったのですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see, so you've had those feelings as well...

dialogue.content: はい、子どもたちのことは可愛いのですが、子どもが苦手な方です。
dialogue.English: Yes, I love my children, but I'm not really a 'kid person.'

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・苦手と感じる中でも本当によく頑張ってこられたと思います
dialogue.English: I see... I think you've done a really wonderful job, even while feeling that it's not your strong suit.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。子どもが成人するまでは育てる義務があるのでですね。　本音は、大人ともっと話したいですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I have a duty to raise them until they're adults. But honestly, I want to talk more with other adults.

dialogue.content: うんうん、もともと人と関わるのがお好きですから、そう思われるのは当然ですよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, since you originally enjoy interacting with people, it's only natural that you'd feel that way.

dialogue.content: そうかも知れません。この半年、話さない日が続いて
dialogue.English: That might be it. These past six months, with days passing without talking,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 特にその欲求が高まっているので、人が好きなんでしょうね。
dialogue.English: that desire has grown especially strong, so I guess I must like being around people.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そのことに気づけたことってすごいなと私は思いました
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. I think it's wonderful that you've recognized that about yourself.

dialogue.content: ええ、人と関わることに携わりたいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I want to be involved in things that connect me with people.

dialogue.content: その思いは大切にしてほしいと思います
dialogue.English: I hope you'll cherish that feeling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 少し感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: May I share an observation?

dialogue.content: ハイお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ご自身は人と関わることが大好きです、そしてとても周りの人をしっかりと見て気遣いできる素晴らしい方だと思いました
dialogue.English: You love interacting with people, and I felt that you are a wonderful person who is very observant and considerate of those around you.

dialogue.content: ただ、今はコロナやお子さんの学校のこともあり、なかなか外に人と関わる機会が無くとても辛くなっておられます
dialogue.English: However, right now, with COVID and your child's school situation, you don't have many opportunities to connect with people outside, which is making things very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 1つご提案があるのですが
dialogue.English: I have one suggestion.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今　こうして家にいる時間を逆にチャンスととらえていただいて、お子さんの遊びに興味をもってみたりしてこれまでよりもさらにお子さんとの関係を深める時間と考えてみるのはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: How would it be to view this time at home as an opportunity—to take an interest in your children's play and use it to deepen your relationship with them even more?

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そして
dialogue.English: And,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コロナが少し落ち着いてきて、お子さんの学校がもう少し落ち着いてきたら、お仕事を少しずつ探してくというのはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: once things with COVID and your child's school settle down a bit more, how about gradually starting to look for a job?

dialogue.content: そうですね、落ち着いたら仕事探しを考えています。
dialogue.English: Yes, once things settle down, I'm thinking of job hunting.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうですよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: 活動があまりないかもしれませんが、とりあえず、PTAの委員会に来年度は入ろうと思っています。
dialogue.English: There may not be many activities, but for now, I'm planning to join a PTA committee next school year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、すごいですね！
dialogue.English: Oh, that's wonderful!

dialogue.content: 少しでも、孤立から離れたくてですね
dialogue.English: I want to get away from this isolation, even if it's just a little.

dialogue.content: うんうん、PTAとかは人と関わる力が活かせそうですね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. The PTA sounds like a place where your ability to connect with others can really shine.

dialogue.content: そうやって少しずつ、人との関わりを増やしていって欲しいと思います
dialogue.English: I hope you can gradually increase your interactions with others that way.

dialogue.content: はい。少しは子どもを通じた知り合いもできそうなので。
dialogue.English: Yes. I think I might be able to make some acquaintances through my children.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、PTAいいですね！
dialogue.English: That's right, the PTA sounds like a great idea!

dialogue.content: 相談員さんが言うように子どもの遊びにももう少し興味持とうと思いました。
dialogue.English: As you suggested, I will try to take more interest in my children's play.

dialogue.content: うんうん、是非試してみてください
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, please do give it a try.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: ご自身がこれから人との関わりを持ちながら、お子さんとの関係も深まって幸せな家族になっていく様子が目に浮かんできます
dialogue.English: I can picture you building connections with others while also deepening your relationship with your children, becoming an even happier family.

dialogue.content: あなたなら出来ると思います！
dialogue.English: I believe you can do it!

dialogue.content: 学校の話題でこどもと話すことが増えるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I might end up talking more with my kids about school.

dialogue.content: そうですね、きっとこれまでよりもさらに関係が深まると思いますよ
dialogue.English: That's right. I'm sure your relationship will deepen even more than before.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたので、本日のご相談はここまでとしたいと思いますが大丈夫でしょうか
dialogue.English: Our time is up, so I'd like to conclude today's session, if that's all right with you.

dialogue.content: 仕事人間だったので、少しだけ休憩と思うことにします。
dialogue.English: I've always been a work-focused person, so I'll try to see this as a bit of a break.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: はい、本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: ご自身を癒す時間いいですね！
dialogue.English: Taking time to heal yourself is a great idea!

dialogue.content: 是非、いい機会ととらえて取り組んでみてください
dialogue.English: Please try to see this as a good opportunity and embrace it.

dialogue.content: それではご相談終了させていただきます大切なお話を聴かせていただき有難うございました
dialogue.English: We'll conclude the session here. Thank you for sharing such important things with me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした！時間オーバーすみません）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time! Sorry we ran over.)

dialogue.content: （いいえ、大丈夫ですよ。お疲れさまでした。）
dialogue.English: (No, it's alright. Thank you as well.)

dialogue.content: （それでは失礼いたします）
dialogue.English: (Well then, goodbye.)

dialogue.content: （失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Goodbye.)
